prospectiveRule: Freeze hypotheses before results. Reserve the next 60 distinct signal sessions and wait for their exits. This runner never opens that sample.
purge: Both signal and official exit must lie within a partition. Do not bridge unknown calendar sessions.
entry: public-eod-t2-open-v1; require recorded signal generation before entry. Actual publication may be unverified. Classify all reconstructed selections as retrospective.
account: KRW 100 million, whole shares, equal target weights, fixed holding-period sleeve budget. Unfilled slots remain cash. No stop or intraday fill assumption.

cost.basis: Illustrative symmetric research stress only (7bp per side); excludes taxes. Actual costs unknown.

candidates.rule: Sort eligible stocks by (stored price momentum minus same-market median momentum) / positive stored volatility20. Tie by baseline rank.
Keep each original TOP10 slot only if its market's median stock momentum exceeds median daily volatility. Other slots stay cash.
An original TOP10 stock with the stored overbought flag sits in cash. No replacement.
Rank by min(B-v1,C-v1) within the same D-v1 eligible universe. Tie by baseline rank.

allocationControl: D-v1 original TOP10 with five percent target per stock per cohort; residual cash. Sector cap requires dated industry memberships.
diagnostics: Date-balanced top and bottom quintiles of model scores and stored factors, same-market momentum bands +/- median daily volatility, high volatility and ticker concentration, C risk flags. Equal-weight eligible universe and simple momentum controls. One change at a time. Retain adverse and null results. No fitted weights.
constraints: Daily official raw open/close price returns only. Report unavailable adjustment, publication, PIT or benchmark evidence. Never mix with observed LIVE, dividends, verified fills, sector attribution or prospective evidence.
